software.name: Once Quartz
software.description:
Send Telegram "view once" and self-destructing photos and videos straight from your Windows PC.

• Sign in with your own Telegram account (your login stays only on your computer)
• Use up to 3 accounts and switch between them in one click
• Pick a chat, add photos or videos, choose View once or a 3s / 10s / 30s / 60s timer, and press SEND ONCE
• See each file's size before sending
• Modern dark glass design

Works in private chats only. Unofficial app, not affiliated with Telegram.
